recursive_published_foundations: Ordinary Berkovich analytic domains, topology and dimension: CLD 11.1.7 and 11.2.3 cite Berkovich and analytic dimension theory. Their deeper published proofs are not independently reconstructed here.

The bound in CLD 12.4.2 is founded on its moment image/tropical dimension results, including 12.2.8--10. We checked the immediate 15.2.1 support proof; we do not claim to reprove the entire tropical dimension construction.

CLD 15.7.1 uses 12.4.7, 12.10.6, 12.11.1, 15.6.1 and 12.9.14 for the canonical analytic tropical structure. These are disclosed published foundations; this draft does not supply a new construction of that structure.

CLD 6.5.2 uses 1.10.2 and finite-dimensional positivity (1.2.13), as well as compact smooth partitions (6.2.8). Its entire immediate proof and the 1.10.2 proof were read; finite-dimensional positivity and smooth partition foundations are not represented as new results.

CLD 7.2.8 uses the positive functional/Radon representation principle and compact smooth scalar density; 7.2.9 uses its local current continuity criterion and finite-dimensional positive order bounds. Complete immediate proofs were checked. No generic representation of signed order-zero currents is inferred.

CLD A.2.5 uses the real Stone-Weierstrass theorem on a compact Hausdorff space. Its application hypotheses and resulting bounds were checked in the full immediate proof, without claiming to reprove Stone-Weierstrass.

The ordinary smooth and current sheaf calculus is the published CLD construction. Our reconstructed multiplier proof is a direct consequence of its checked differential duality and smooth J/Leibniz identities.
reading_scope: Complete immediate statements/proofs and surrounding definitions for each actual use, drawn from the bound full primary source. No claim to have read every page of CLD or all context bodies.
